invariants.title: Public documented command references have recognized route structure
invariants.property: Inspected public Core command references must have recognized CLI route structure; arguments, preconditions and execution are not verified.
invariants.threshold: 0 missing command routes and 0 unqualified strong control claims

invariants.title: Capability declarations satisfy structural registry checks
invariants.property: Capability entries must use accepted states and control levels; shipped entries cite recognized routes and mechanical claims declare nonempty evidence references, whose existence and adequacy are not verified.

invariants.title: Required validation suites are declared
invariants.property: The repository must declare required targeted, regression, and invariant validation suites.
